name: Verify request for access or equipment is classified as Service Request
objective: Validate that when a user requests access, equipment, or new services, the assistant correctly classifies it as a Service Request.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Describe a request for access or equipment
steps.testData: "I need access to the Finance shared drive"
steps.expectedResult: Message is submitted to the assistant

steps.description: Verify the assistant classifies the request as a Service Request
steps.expectedResult: The assistant identifies this as a Service Request (not an Incident)

steps.description: Verify the proposed ticket type is displayed to the user
steps.expectedResult: The assistant communicates the classification as 'Service Request' before proceeding
